about: Runes e2e seed (run 2026-10-24-runesets-full-stack, U1). Materialised by tools/sandbox/runes-seed.mjs and the Rust e2e snapshot test; rules in README.md beside this file.

tokens.<APP>: install root: vidar.json, contracts/, runes-e2e/ (rulesLibrary), runtime/runes/
tokens.<WORK>: project folder, a git repo with a linked worktree at .worktrees/e2e (steps)
tokens.<WORK_SLUG>: memory_slug(<WORK>): every char not ASCII alphanumeric becomes '-'
tokens.<MEMORY_LIB>: slug("memory-" + <WORK_SLUG>): the memory import library id (rules/import/split.rs slug: 4 words, 32 chars)

cases.1: agents[claude-kit] holds only kit/kit; kit/sets/kit.md has no slots
cases.2: kit/sets/kit.layer.json modules jira + openai-docs bring atlassian + openaiDeveloperDocs; <HOME>/.codex/config.toml lists both again
cases.3: discovery of <HOME>/.codex/config.toml mcp rows against the kit modules
cases.4: steps[git-worktree]: discover from <WORK>/.worktrees/e2e names <WORK>/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
cases.7: discovery offers skills and agents beside rules and memory under <HOME>/.claude
cases.8: agents[claude-rendered-bare] refs its generation's row set and the fork-short fork
cases.9: gen-claude-rendered-bare-0c4f2b19 keeps a row set; gen-index names 5e1d0a7c
cases.10: locations[E2E] add-on set vidar-recall from rulesLibrary runes-e2e
cases.11: agents[codex-rendered-bare] with falcon.hostedCodex and kit/kit (modules bring MCP servers)
